sources: Junction Point (arts unit). Skill 3, sk_wpn_funnel_0018 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData; values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level: atk_up, atk_up2, max_stack, duration). Its cardAttributeModifier (attribute 54, Nature DMG + nature_dmg_up) and skills 1-2 stay in the stat panel. Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0030_zhuangfy.md rows J1-J4.

Four abilityEvent 206 handlers (the wielder applies a buff), one per CheckBuffIdInContextAdvanced checkType 1 tag: 458037917 Heat, 1425735059 Cryo, -1640994543 Electric, -575106878 Nature Susceptibility; and one abilityEvent 126 handler (the wielder applies an Arts Infliction); each with CheckOriginSkillType [6] (from a combo). Each creates buff_wpn_funnel_0018_layer on the wielder (atk_up) and on every other team member (CharacterTeamFinder + ExcludeTarget of the wielder, atk_up2 into its atk_up): attribute 2 formulaItem 6, ATK %; stackingType 11 with priority key atk_up, maxStackCnt from max_stack: layers, each its own `duration`. No timed marker: an Arts Susceptibility (all four tags) runs all four handlers, so four applications (the cap keeps max_stack); written as four triggers, one per tag, as the data has them.

Open: whether an infliction that forms a reaction counts as applying one (test 35's question; inflictionApplied excludes it); two wielders' layers (stackingType 11 with a priority key across owners: batch-3 B2 residue) are kept per wielder.

Description (report J2): "When the wielder applies Arts Susceptibility or Arts Infliction with a combo skill, the wielder gains ATK +{atk_up} while other operators gain ATK +{atk_up2} for {duration}s. Max stacks: {max_stack}. Duration of each stack is counted separately."

buffs.label: Junction Point: ATK (other operators)
buffs.note: The same game buff on the teammates, with atk_up2 assigned to its atk_up.
